HOW TO ORDER FROM OUR FARM

Real food. Simple process. Handled with care.

Whether you're new to farm-direct shopping or a long-time customer, here's everything you need to know about how to order & what to expect.

1. START YOUR ONLINE ORDER

Browse our online farm store to see what's currently in season and in stock. Everything you see is raised or grown with intention - right here on our farm or in partnership with farms we trust.

Order what you need for the week, the month, or somewhere in between. Many customers stock up to meet the delivery minimum and skip extra trips to the store.

 
Loading image:
Loading image:
 
WHAT WE OFFER

Shop by product category:

Grass-Fed and Finished Beef & Lamb
Pasture-Raised Chicken & Turkey
Pasture-Raised Pork
Eggs & Honey
Seasonal organic Produce
Artisan Foods - small-batch items when available

2. CHOOSE PICKUP OR DELIVERY

We offer weekly farm pickup in Brenham or home delivery in Brenham, along the 290 corridor, and into the Greater Houston area.

Loading image:
FARM PICKUP
Pickup at our farm in Brenham, TX

Pickup Saturday (8am-6pm) if you order by Wednesday at midnight
Pickup Wednesday (8am-6pm) if you order by Saturday at midnight

Your order will be packed and ready for self-serve, contactless pickup at the farm. Full instructions will be provided after checkout.

*Perfect for locals or weekend visitors who want to swing by the farm.

Loading image:
HOME DELIVERY
Home Delivery - Brenham, 290 Corridor & Greater Houston
In Brenham: Delivered Tuesday if you order by Saturday at midnight. Minimum order of $125. $10 delivery fee under $125. Free delivery on orders $125+.
Along the 290 Corridor & Greater Houston: Delivered Wednesday if you order by Saturday at midnight. Minimum order of $200. $25 delivery fee under $300. Free delivery on orders $300+.
Delivery zip codes are in the Q&A below.

*Ideal for customers who want to stock up and have it brought to their door.

2. RECEIVE & ENJOY

We harvest and pack everything to order so it's fresh, seasonal, and ready for your table.

Your box arrives full of pasture-raised meats, eggs, and just-picked produce - ready for real meals and nourishing moments.

From weeknight dinners to weekend slow roasts, it's honest food you'll feel good about serving and savoring.

OUR FARM STORY

At Whitehurst Farm, we believe food should be real, relationships should be honest, and land should be treated with care. We're Michael and Leslie Marchand, owners and stewards of this family-run, regenerative farm in Brenham, Texas - where we grow seasonal produce and raise animals in ways that honor the rhythms of nature and the values of our community.

Loading image:
 
THE EARLY DAYS

Although we didn't grow up farming., we're deeply inspired by our family's rich agricultural heritage. Whitehurst Farm - named in honor of Michael's grandfather, Emmett Whitehurst - began with a simple idea: feed our family well, live closer to the land, and raise our kids with purpose.

What started in a suburban backyard has grown into a full-time regenerative farm in Central Texas. We've learned through experience, partnerships, and a whole lot of humility. Every decision - from what we plant to how we care for our animals - is rooted in respect: for the land, the lives in our care, and the people we feed.

WHAT WE GROW & RAISE

We grow a diverse mix of seasonal vegetables, leafy greens and root crops - all grown with care and without chemicals.

Our animals - chickens, turkeys, pigs, and cattle - live outdoors, eat well, and are treated with respect from start to finish.

We believe good food starts with good stewardship, and everything we grow and raise reflects that commitment. The result is clean, nourishing food you can feel good about feeding your family.

 
Loading image:
Loading image:
 
WHAT WE BELIEVE

We believe in:

Feeding people real food, raised with integity
Regenerating the land, not just sustaining it
Knowing our customers and serving them well
Supporting the local food economy and fellow farmers
Doing things slowly, seasonally, and the right way
BEYOND THE FARM

Farming isn't something we do alone. We work closely with a small group of trusted farms, chefs, and artisans who share our standards and philosophy. These relationships allow us to offer a wide range of seasonal items, and support a thriving local food system beyond our own acreage.

 
Loading image:
Loading image:
 
WELCOME

Whether you're just discovering local food or have been sourcing direct for years - we're so glad you're here.

We're honored to grow real food for real families, and we hope it brings ease to your kitchen and meaning to your meals.

-Michael & Leslie Marchand
